title: Conversation
description: Send a message, watch text arrive, and inspect the exact model request. Completed turns stay in this session's model context.
prompt: Explain how a progressive agent runtime works.
expected: A streamed Markdown reply and a new request in the inspector.

title: Function tools
description: Let the agent call uppercase through the real tool dispatcher. Inspect the arguments, result and follow-up model request.
prompt: Make this uppercase: small steps, visible progress.
expected: One uppercase tool execution followed by a final response.

title: Approval gate
description: The save_note tool waits for your decision. Approve to update the session note, or reject and verify that nothing was written.
prompt: Ship a small version, learn from real usage, and iterate.
expected: An approval card before a memory-only note write.

title: Report artifact
description: Build a small Markdown report as a finalized in-memory artifact. Open it in the inspector or download a copy.
prompt: Create a report about the benefits of small, explicit runtime contracts.
expected: A tool result and an immutable report with a content digest.

title: Validation failure
description: The scripted model deliberately sends an invalid tool argument. The dispatcher rejects it before execution. Use the valid-tool example to compare.
expected: A failed run, a validation error, and zero executed tools. Scripted provider only.

title: Cancellation
description: Start a longer response and stop it while it streams. Refresh or reconnect to inspect the cancelled run; closing observation alone does not cancel it.
prompt: Walk through the lifecycle of a managed run, slowly.
expected: Partial text followed by a cancelled state when you choose Stop.
